Information
Passive: Toggle

"Your verdict stands. I am the executior delivering your Punishment" 

Passive

[Passive, Toggle] Silent Movement - The player makes zero noise, undetectable by Sculk or Sense Sound Wave.

Passive

[Active, In-Slot] Remove - The user instantly breaks Barriers. 5 Second Cooldown

[Active In-Slot] Dispel - The user automatically removes certain conditions from the user. The user removes various conditions from the target on it. 3 Second Cooldown. (configurable in config)

[Active, In-Slot] Eraser - The user's attacks on enemies damage their Current MP. If the target has less than 15% of the user's EP, they are instantly killed, other wise each attack reduces their Current MP by 5% (2.5% if they have an ultimate skill). 2 Second Cooldown.

[Active, In-Slot] Necrosis - This applies the Necrotic Effect to a target. Necrotic makes it so they cannot regenerate Magicules and Regeneration Skills do not work. This has a 30 Second Cooldown and the condition lasts 25 Seconds.

[Active, In-Slot] Judgement - When used, Remove, Dispel, Eraser and Necrosis are all used together, but enhanced.

Dispel now deals bonus damage directly to the target based off the Barrier Points destroyed (1 Barrier Point = 5 Damage)

Dispel now bypasses Resistances and Nullifications

Eraser will instantly kill any target target with less than 50% of the user's EP by reducing their Current EP to 0%, otherwise reduce their Current EP by the difference between the User and Target's Current EP (0 if the target has higher EP) + 35% of the target's current EP.

Necrosis will apply the Necrotic Effect for 1 minute.

This has a 1,440 second cooldown.

[Active, Hold] Existence Concealment - The user completely hides themselves, with Presence Concealment. This becomes togglable when mastered.

[Active, Press] Sure Hit of Assassination (Requires Mastery, Requires Learning) - The user dashes forward, cloaking themselves with Existence Concealment. This attack does the Player's Attack x 5. It has a 5 second cooldown. It will apply weapon effects too.

Information
Points to Master: 25000
Passive: Toggle

Passive

[Passive, True] Unyield:

Once a mob is named by the user, it will gain 1 (2 with Mastery) Unyielding Point each 5s that it’s 30 blocks around the player, this will decrease if the mob is too far away. If a subordinate dies to a damage source not from the owner, the user will gain 10% of the sub’s EP for each 60 points (5 minutes) it has - The maximum amount of EP can gain is 100% = 600 points (50 minutes).

To gain the fallen Subordinates’ skills/magics/battlewills, the Subordinate needs to have at least 120 points for Skills, Battlewills, Magic, and 600 points for Unique Skills. 6,000 for Ultimate Skills.

[Passive, In-Slot] Life Domination: Natural Domain

While this skill is In-Slot, the user can absorb the magicules in the surronding air. The user's SHP and AP regenerate much faster. (4x faster by default).

[Passive, Toggle] Hope's Gift:

When Toggled on, the user and their subordinates gain 100% crit chance and a 25% Dodge chance

[Passive, True] Life Domination: superior life force

The user cannot have their energy drained by an attack that has less than 75% of their EP. any draining effects on the user are cut in half(75% when mastered)

Active

[Active, Press] Backup:

Upon activation, at the MP cost equal to 25% of the user’s max MP, spawn an immobile Body with all your EP and no skills at where the user is. When activated again, transfer the user’s soul to where the Body is and spawn a new Body where the user is, swap their Equipments in Armor and Hand slots (other slots are untouched) - Shift activate to remove the Backup Body. If the user dies when there’s a Backup available, automatically transfer them to that Backup (If KeepInventory is off, items in Armor and Hand slots of the user will spawn where they’re supposed to die, else those will spawn where the Backup is). Only works Multi-Dimensionally with Mastery.

[Active, Press] Life Domination: Empower

When used,you and all nearby subordinates gain Resistance degrade, akk if the subordinates and the user gain Strengthened 5 and Resistance 2

[Active, In-slot]Fortitude

While this mode is in slot, the user's sword is coating in pale blue flames, and the user drains the life force of anyone they strike, to various degrees based off several factors. This art does have a 7 Second Cooldown.

If the target has less than 30% of your EP, this skill will drain 80% of their HP and SHP in a single strike.

The the target has less than 50% of your EP, this skill will drain 60% of their HP and SHP in a single strike.

The the target has less than 70% of your EP, this skill will drain 40% of their HP and SHP in a single strike.

The the target has less than 50% of your EP and has no Ultimate Skill, this will drain 99% of their HP and SHP in a single strike.

[Active, Hold] Life Domination: Reconstruction

While this mode is held, the user begins to regenerate their HP and SHP alongside their subordinates HP and SHP at 50 a tick. Every second held, costs the user 10,000 Magicules.

Information
Points to Master: 15000
Passive: Toggle

Passive

[Passive, In-Slot] Breaking Point - While you have the Rampage Effect, the durability damage you cause from attacking armor will increase based off the Rampage Level.

[Passive, True (Mastery Required)] Law Breaker - While you have this skill mastered, you become immune to the conditions and laws of skills while your Rampaging. This means you are immune to the effects of Infinity Prison, Uriel, Law Manipulation, Magicule Poisoning and even Anti-Skill.

[Passive, True] Stampede - While you have Rampage above level 15, if you were to die, you instead are not killed, surviving even past instant kill skills. This reduces your level of Rampage by 15, and there is a chance that you're taken over by your own Wrath. (This can be change in the config, default is a 25% Chance. While taken over, the player is unable to control themselves as the Satanael Skill takes over and begins to attack and destroy everything.

Actives

[Active, In-Slot] Anger Point - When taking damage, there is a chance of increasing your level of Rampage each time you take damage. (This cannot raise your Rampage above level 10. - Can be changed in configs)

[Active, Hold] Magicule Breeder Reactor - While held down, gives the player MP equal to 4% (6% at Mastery) of their maximum every 100 ticks. Each usage has a 5% (10% at mastery) chance to add 1 level of Rampage and 1 (2 at mastery) minute of duration which rises to 10% if the player's MP is past their natural maximum. With Mastery, becomes a toggle ability instead of hold.

[Active, Hold] Output Control - While held, the user can scroll and modify Satanael's output by 10% at a time, when Satanael is below 90%, Rampage is replaced with the Magicule Reactor effect.

Breeder Reacter Effect

Per level

+3 Armor

+15 Atk

+0.01 Atk Speed

+0.005 Speed

+0.005 Swim Speed

+ 0.05 Knockback Resist

Information
Points to Master: 1000
Passive: Toggle

Active

[Active, Hold] Evil Eater - This is a predation ability. It is similar to Gluttony's Predator with the sole exception of it's ability to consume item's as well.

[Active, Press] Stomach - This is a storage ability which houses stacks of 98. It has 24 pages.

[Active, Press] Devour - The user can devour the item in their hand. This gives them 10% (25% when mastered) of its EP. This will also give the user skills related to the engravements on the item.

Information
Points to Master: 500

Passive

[True Passive] Faithful - The user's owner is always their God, even if they were killed by their God, as long as they possess this skill and have their Faith, their owner cannot be changed. 

[Passive, In-slot] Holy Manipulation - While this is in slot, the user's faith in their God improves their Holy Damage. This increases all Holy Damage by 2x. When this skill is mastered, it also grants the user Holy Attack Resistance degradation.

Active

[ Active - Hold ] Devotion
While this is held, the user begins to chant, this gains Mastery for Secret of Faith.

[Active, Press] Faith Directory - Opens a Menu to display a list of all faiths, can be used to view the list of people in faiths and their roles.

Information
Points to Master: 500

Passive

[Passive, In-slot] Faith Management -

While this skill is in slot, the user increases their Subordinates Prayer skill's spiritron generation.
(Certain skills made this a passive skill, such as; Raphael, Asmodeus and Sariel)

Active

[Active, Press] Faith Directory - Opens a Menu to display a list of all faiths, can be used to view the list of people in faiths and their roles.

[Active, Press] Priest Management - Opens a menu to display a list of your faithful, and lets you turn up to 3 into priests

[Active - Hold/Scroll] Spiritron Control - The user can gather Spiritrons much faster than through the usage of Prayer. The user is able to generate a number of Spiritrons equal to their Learning Speed x Subordinate Number per second. This is doubled if they possess a skill such as Saint.

(The user can scroll to modify the output of their Spiritrons. This permits the god to reduce their Holy Damage or increase their Holy Damage up to 4 times by scrolling them to 0% or up to 400%.

The Spiritron Costs of the Holy Magics increased or decrease by the percentage.)

Information
Points to Master: 1000
Passive: Toggle

Passive

[Passive, True] Abundance - Your Magicule Regeneration increases by x2 when below 85% Magicules.

[Passive, Toggled] Family Account - Your Magicules are shared with all nearby subordinates.

Active

[Active, Held] Snack For Later! - While held, boost your Magicule Regeneration by 5x (10x when mastered), if your Magicules are at 100%, you instead begin to generated Stored Magicules.

[Active, Press] Family Bonds! - When used, open a skill menu of any ally, select any skill they have, and by both parties paying the MP Cost + The Stored Magicules of the cost being used, the user gains that skill. When mastered, this can be used to copy Unique Skills, however, only up to four.

Information
Points to Master: 1,500
Passive: Toggle

Note: This will store your version of Uriel inside of Shub-Niggurath's [ Skill Storage ]

Active

[Active, Press] Skill Storage

When used, it will open up a menu containing all the skills you've owned at least one (permanantly) after obtaining Shub-Niggurath. This lets you re-create the skill if you lose it, however it comes at the cost of Shub-Niggurath's Mastery. You can delete skills within it to gain mastery, however they cannot be obtained again without the usage of analysis, food chain or predation abilities.

[Active, Press] Skill Creation:

The user can create skills with Shub-Niggurath assuming they do not already have the skill. These skills are permanent, however they cannot become mastered and require an MP cost.

[Active, Press] Skill Duplication:

The user can open a Skill Duplication menu, which is full of skills they've made more than three times, all of these skills are able to be mastered, and do not cost MP to create for the user.

[Active, Press] Skill Gifting:

The user can attempt to bestow a skill they have analyzed inside of Skill Storage, this works fine for all non-Unique and Ultimate Skills. If you attempt to bestow a Unique or Ultimate Skill, both the user and target loose the MP cost of the ability, and there is a chance the target is not compatible with that skill. (80% chance) meaning it will be removed on death and cannot be mastered.

They can only be compatible with one skill.
